_meta.title: Freedom of Thought Report: treatment of atheists, humanists and the non-religious
_meta.what: Humanists International rates every country in four areas (constitution and government; education and children; family, community and society; free expression). Each rating is set by the worst "boundary condition" found. 1 Free and Equal, 2 Mostly Satisfactory, 3 Systemic Discrimination, 4 Severe Discrimination, 5 Grave Violations. "value" is the worst of the four ratings (our summary; the report itself gives no single overall score). Conditions list the specific findings, such as blasphemy or apostasy punishable by death.
